transcript.en: So Luke, for our next psychology assignment we have to do something on sleep and dreams.
transcript.zh: 好，卢克，下一份心理学作业我们必须要做一些关于睡眠和做梦相关的了。

transcript.en: Right. I've just read an article suggesting why we tend to forget most of our dreams soon after we wake up.
transcript.zh: 好。我刚看完的一篇文章讲到为什么我们一醒来后就会忘掉刚才梦里的大部分内容。

transcript.en: I mean, most of my dreams aren't that interesting anyway, but what it said was that if we remembered everything,
transcript.zh: 我的意思是说，尽管我们做的许多梦都那么无趣，但是如果你记住了所有的梦，

transcript.en: we might get mixed up about what actually happened and what we dreamed. So it's a sort of protection.I hadn't heard that idea before.
transcript.zh: 我们可能就会把真实发生在生活里的和在梦里发生的事情混在一起。因此这算是一种保护机制吧。我之前并没有听说过。

transcript.en: I'd always assumed that it was just that we didn't have room in our memories for all that stuff.
transcript.zh: 我一直认为是我们的记忆里没有那么多的空间去记住这一切。

transcript.en: Me too. What do you think about the idea that our dreams may predict the future?
transcript.zh: 我也这么觉得。那你觉得我们做的梦会预知未来嘛？

transcript.en: It's a belief that you get all over the world.
transcript.zh: 全世界的人可能都是这么想的。

transcript.en: Yeah, lots of people have a story of it happening to them,
transcript.zh: 嗯，这种事发生在很多人身上，

transcript.en: but the explanation I've read is that for each dream that comes true, we have thousands that don't,
transcript.zh: 但是我之前看书上说是这么解释的，有的梦可能真的发生了，

transcript.en: but we don't notice those, we don't even remember them.
transcript.zh: 但是还有更多的梦是没有发生在现实的，但是我们就是没有注意，或者说我们压根就记不住了。

transcript.en: We just remember the ones where something in the real world, like a view or an action, happens to trigger a dream memory.
transcript.zh: 我们只能记住一些发生在真实世界中的事，比如说一个风景或者一个动作，从而触发了梦里的记忆。

transcript.en: Right. So it's just a coincidence really.
transcript.zh: 是的。所以这就是个巧合。

transcript.en: Something else I read about is what they call segmented sleeping.
transcript.zh: 我还读过一些被称为分段睡眠的资料。

transcript.en: That's a theory that hundreds of years ago, people used to get up in the middle of the night and have a chat or something to eat, then go back to bed.So I tried it myself.
transcript.zh: 这个理论是说几百年前，人们半夜起床开始聊天或者吃东西，然后再继续回去睡觉。因此我就自己试了一下 。

transcript.en: Why?
transcript.zh: 为什么？

transcript.en: Well it's meant to make you more creative.I don't know why.
transcript.zh: 嗯，这会让你变得更有创造力。我不知道为什么

transcript.en: But I gave it up after a week. It just didn't fit in with my lifestyle.
transcript.zh: 但是我一周之后就放弃了。这和我的生活方式不搭。

transcript.en: But most pre-school children have a short sleep in the day don't they?
transcript.zh: 但是很多学龄前儿童不是都会在白天小睡一会吗？

transcript.en: There was an experiment some students did here last term to see at what age kids should stop having naps.
transcript.zh: 上个学期一些学生做了个实验去观察哪个年龄段的小孩会在白天不小憩了。

transcript.en: But they didn't really find an answer.
transcript.zh: 但是他们也没得到啥结论。

transcript.en: They spent a lot of time working out the most appropriate methodology,but the results didn't seem to show any obvious patterns.
transcript.zh: 他们花了很多时间去找到一个最合适的方法，但是结果似乎也没呈现出什么明显的模式。

transcript.en: Right. Anyway, let's think about our assignment.
transcript.zh: 是的。算了，还是说一下我们自己的作业吧。

transcript.en: Last time I had problems with the final stage, where we had to describe and justify how successful we thought we'd been.
transcript.zh: 上次我在最后一个阶段是有问题的，这个阶段要求我们描述并证明我们自认为有多成功。

transcript.en: I struggled a bit with the action plan too.
transcript.zh: 而且我在行动计划上也遇到了一些困难。

transcript.en: I was OK with the planning, but I got marked down for the self-assessment as well.
transcript.zh: 我的计划部分是可以的，但是我也在自我评估的部分被扣分了。

transcript.en: And I had big problems with the statistical stuff, that's where I really lost marks. Right.
transcript.zh: 我在统计部分是有很大问题的，这才是真正丢分的地方。是的。

transcript.en: So shall we plan what we have to do for this assignment? OK.
transcript.zh: 因此让我们来计划一下这次作业我们要做的事情吧。好。

transcript.en: First, we have to decide on our research question. So how about 'Is there a relationship between hours of sleep and number of dreams?
transcript.zh: 首先，我们必须要先确定我们的研究问题。“睡眠时间和做梦数量之间有关么？”这个怎么样？

transcript.en: OK. Then we need to think about who we'll do the study on. About 12 people?
transcript.zh: 可以。之后我们要想一下我们要在谁身上做研究？12个人可以吗？

transcript.en: Right. And shall we use other psychology students?
transcript.zh: 好的。那我们找心理系的学生？

transcript.en: Let's use people from a different department. What about history?
transcript.zh: 我们还是找其他院系的同学吧。你觉得历史系的怎么样？

transcript.en: Yes, they might have interesting dreams! Or literature students?
transcript.zh: 可以的，他们的梦可能很有趣！或者是文学系也行吧？

transcript.en: I don't really know any.
transcript.zh: 我一个也不认识。

transcript.en: OK, forget that idea. Then we have to think about our methodology.
transcript.zh: 好吧，算了。之后我们要想一下我们的研究方法。

transcript.en: So we could use observation, but that doesn't seem appropriate.
transcript.zh: 我们可以用观察法，但又似乎不太合适。

transcript.en: No. It needs to be self-reporting I think. And we could ask them to answer questions online.
transcript.zh: 肯定不行。我觉得得用自我报告的方法。我们可以让他们在线回答问题。

transcript.en: But in this case, paper might be better as they'll be doing it straight after they wake up...in fact while they're still half-asleep.
transcript.zh: 如果这样的话，纸质的问卷可能会更好，因为这样他们就可以在醒来之后直接填写了，毕竟那时他们还处于半睡着状态。

transcript.en: Right. And we'll have to check the ethical guidelines for this sort of research.
transcript.zh: 好的。针对这种研究我们必须要去查一下道德准则。

transcript.en: Mm, because our experiment involves humans, so there are special regulations. Yes, I had a look at those for another assignment I did.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们的实验还是涉及到人的，所以肯定有一些特别的要求。是的，我之前的一个作业有看过一些相关的资料。

transcript.en: There's a whole section on risk assessment, and another section on making sure they aren't put under any unnecessary stress.
transcript.zh: 其中有一个部分是风险评估，另外一部分是确保实验者没有受到任何不必要的压力。

transcript.en: Let's hope they don't have any bad dreams!
transcript.zh: 我们还是希望他们不会做噩梦吧！

transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 嗯嗯。

transcript.en: Then when we've collected all our data we have to analyse it and calculate the correlation between our two variables,
transcript.zh: 之后我们要去分析所有我们收集到的数据，

transcript.en: that's time sleeping and number of dreams and then present our results visually in a graph.
transcript.zh: 然后计算睡眠时间和做梦数量这两个变量之间的关系，最后以图片的形式来呈现我们的结果。

transcript.en: Right. And the final thing is to think about our research and evaluate it.So that seems quite straight forward.
transcript.zh: 好的。最后就是要回顾一下我们的研究，然后做一个评价。这似乎就简单多了。

transcript.en: Yeah. So now let's ...
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们现在该...
